camel_example: aliyun esa GetWafFilter --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1 --Target characteristics --Type http_custom_cc --Phase http_bot
description_en: Retrieves matching engine information for a site at a given WAF phase, which defines how the WAF detects and handles various network requests
description_zh: 获取指定站点在特定WAF阶段的匹配引擎信息，这些信息定义了WAF如何检测和处理不同类型的网络请求
kebab_example: aliyun esa get-waf-filter --site-id 1 --phase http_bot --target characteristics --type http_custom_cc --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetWafFilter

parameters.description_en: Specifies the ID of the site. You can get this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.
parameters.description_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
parameters.help_en: Specifies the ID of the site. You can get this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.description_en: Specifies the WAF phase from which to retrieve the matching engine information.
parameters.description_zh: WAF阶段，指定要查询的匹配引擎信息所处的WAF阶段。
parameters.help_en: Specifies the WAF phase from which to retrieve the matching engine information
parameters.help_zh: WAF阶段，指定要查询的匹配引擎信息所处的WAF阶段
parameters.name: phase

parameters.description_en: Specifies the application target of the matching engine.
parameters.description_zh: 取值目标，定义匹配引擎的应用目标。
parameters.help_en: Specifies the application target of the matching engine
parameters.help_zh: 取值目标，定义匹配引擎的应用目标
